high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up of a piece of parchment with a handwritten note on it. The parchment appears aged, with some edges slightly burnt or charred, suggesting it might be old or has been exposed to fire. The note is written in a formal, somewhat apologetic tone. The text on the parchment reads: "Everything has gone wrong. Gods, I killed him... and the Worldstone shard, the only thing that could bring you back, is out of my reach.
